description: Games Master: prepare (unsigned) paying the bribe on your crew when it is picked by an Informant event (an approve of half its debt, then payBribe). Only the crew's owner, only while the event runs; unpaid crews are charged in full afterwards.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.
